hunks.baseline: Just as I smiled contentedly and began watching Lee Seowol’s reaction, a sharp, ringing voice came from the distance.
hunks.sol: I smiled in satisfaction and was about to study Lee Seowol’s reaction when a sharp voice rang out from the distance.

hunks.baseline: “What are you grinning so foolishly about?”
hunks.sol: “What are you grinning like a fool for?”

hunks.baseline: With Jin Wikyung and Wipeng flanking him, he seized me by the nape before I had a chance to say anything.
hunks.sol: Flanked by Jin Wikyung and Wipeng, he strode up and seized me by the nape before I could protest.

hunks.baseline: “The road ahead is long. Hurry up and follow me.”
hunks.sol: “We have a long road ahead. Hurry up and follow me.”

hunks.baseline: The faces of the people behind me quickly grew distant.
hunks.sol: Everyone’s faces rapidly receded into the distance.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung waved a handkerchief with reddened eyes and shouted,
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung waved a handkerchief, his eyes red, and shouted, “My youngest! Come back safe and sound!”

hunks.baseline: “Our youngest! Come back safe and sound!”
*……That only makes me more nervous!*
hunks.sol: *……Why would you say it like that? Now I’m even more nervous!*
